description: Conversion of roof space to habitable use to include a rear dormer, a side dormer and 1 x front roof light.
decision_conditions: The proposed development, by reason of the introduction of the side dormer extension, would result in an unacceptable and visually intrusive alteration to the original roof form of the host dwelling. The side dormer would interrupt the previously unbroken side roof slopes through their cumulative impact which would erode the simple and coherent roofscape of this group of properties. The rear dormer due to its size, unsympathetic design would thereby appear as a discordant addition within the street scene. Overall, the development would fail to preserve the character and appearance of the Conservation Area causing less than substantial harm to the conservation area without any notable public benefit. Therefore, the proposal would be contrary to Policy D3 of The London Plan (2021), Policy BE1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan: Part One - Strategic Policies and  Policies DMHB 4, DMHB11, DMHB12 and DMHD1 of the Hillingdon Local Plan - Part Two (2020).

The decision to REFUSE planning permission has been taken having regard to the policies and proposals in the Hillingdon Local Plan Part 1 (2012) and Part 2 (2020) set out below, including Supplementary Planning Guidance, and to all relevant material considerations, including The London Plan - The Spatial Development Strategy for London consolidated with alterations since 2011 (2016) (2024) and national guidance.
